title: Transcribe Audio & Video Meetings
description: Convert recorded meetings, voice memos, or podcasts into text transcripts offline, without uploading the audio.
setupSteps: Download MacWhisper from goodsnooze.gumroad.com/l/macwhisper, Jan from jan.ai, or Open WebUI from openwebui.com.
Open MacWhisper or Open WebUI and select the Whisper Large-v3 model in settings.
Drag and drop any audio or video file to start automated transcription.
Export formatted text or transcript timestamps with 1-click.
sampleWorkflow: Drop audio file → Instant GPU transcription → Export markdown notes

title: Private Document Search & Summaries
description: Search across local PDFs, Word docs, and notes without uploading sensitive company or personal files to the cloud.
setupSteps: Download AnythingLLM Desktop from anythingllm.com, Jan from jan.ai, GPT4All from gpt4all.io, or Msty from msty.app.
Create a local workspace named "Confidential Documents".
Select Llama 3.2 3B as your default local execution model.
Drag PDFs into the workspace and chat with your local documents.
sampleWorkflow: Drag PDFs into workspace → Local vector indexing → Chat & summarize

title: Offline Dictation & Writing Cleanup
description: Transform rough voice dictation, ramble notes, or quick thoughts into polished memos, emails, and articles.
setupSteps: Download LM Studio from lmstudio.ai, Jan from jan.ai, GPT4All from gpt4all.io, or Msty from msty.app.
Search and download Phi-3.5-mini-instruct in the model catalog.
Load the model in the chat tab with system prompt "Clean up dictation".
Paste voice text to get instant clean prose.
sampleWorkflow: Paste rough voice dictation → Click Clean Up → Get polished memo

title: Local Code & Complex Brainstorming
description: Get deep step-by-step reasoning, code suggestions, and architectural analysis running entirely on your Mac GPU.
setupSteps: Download Ollama from ollama.com, Jan from jan.ai, GPT4All from gpt4all.io, or Open WebUI from openwebui.com.
Open Ollama or Jan desktop client (runs natively on Apple Silicon).
Pull or select model: deepseek-r1:8b
Connect any desktop client (Jan from jan.ai, GPT4All from gpt4all.io, Msty from msty.app, Open WebUI from openwebui.com).
sampleWorkflow: Ask complex technical prompt → Local GPU reasoning → Detailed response

title: Fast On-Device Q&A & Writing
description: Lightweight, rapid response assistant for daily questions, email drafting, and copy editing with minimal RAM footprint.
setupSteps: Download LM Studio from lmstudio.ai, Jan from jan.ai, GPT4All from gpt4all.io, Msty from msty.app, or Open WebUI from openwebui.com.
Find Qwen 2.5 7B in the recommended models list.
Click Download and launch the local chat interface.
Start instant zero-latency conversation.
sampleWorkflow: Open local chat → Type query → Instant private response
